verdict_reason: Prior findings are addressed, but the two new mapping-failure tests copy their spy set-up and check different counters.

todos.issue: The two new mapping-failure tests copy the same set-up: receive_shouldNotThrow_andCountV2AsFailed_whenV2MappingFails (lines 262-266) and receive_shouldNotThrow_andCountV4AsFailed_whenV4MappingFails (lines 282-286) each spy pimsPayloadMapper, stub one mapToVn to throw and build a second NotificationSqsListener. Their assertions also drift apart: the v2 test checks the failed counter only for 0.2.0 and 0.4.0, while the v4 test checks all four.
todos.fix: Must: one home for the 'one stream fails to map' set-up, and every such test checks the forwarded and failed counters for all four schema versions. One way: a @ParameterizedTest over the best-effort versions (0.2.0, 0.3.0, 0.4.0) with a private helper that returns a listener whose mapper throws for the given version.
